about: HolyWorld TNT types (wiki.holyworld.me: lite/region/tnt.md, prime/items/custom_items.md). A primed TNT is identified by its (possibly hidden) custom name, then its block state, then its starting fuse. 'match' patterns are Java regexes on the normalised name (colour codes and small caps removed, lower case, ё → е) and are guesses until a capture confirms how the server names primed TNT. 'radius' is the explosion power the optional ring shows (vanilla TNT = 4); 'cube' is the edge of a cubic blast. A copy at config/skirmish/tables/tnt_timer.json overrides this file.
